name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: The colonist studying Plankton's distance is lower than both Dasari and the colonist studying Lichen.
Either Lichen goes with 21 ly or Rios goes with Lichen.
Dasari goes with at least one of Diatoms or 15 ly.
If 21 ly does not go with Fontaine, then Algae goes with Dasari.
Algae, Lichen, and 17 ly go with Bauer, Dasari, and Fontaine, in some order.
